name: CV-Bench-3D-gt3dloc-v2
description: A benchmark for 3D camera/agent localization that measures models' ability to recover accurate 6-DoF poses in real-world scenes using ground-truth 3D location data. It focuses on precise spatial localization and pose regression, evaluating both translation and rotation fidelity. Typical use cases include visual localization, SLAM evaluation, and downstream robotics perception tasks.
evaluation_method: translation and rotation error metrics (mean/median position error in meters and orientation error in degrees), often supplemented by accuracy within specified thresholds
reputation: A specialized dataset for 3D localization research with modest adoption in the robotics and localization subcommunity.
